name: spacefast
description: Publish to the web from Kimi Code. Build, host, and share sites and apps at live URLs via the Spacefast MCP server.
author: Spacefast

interface.shortDescription: Publish sites and apps to live URLs
interface.longDescription: Spacefast lets Kimi Code publish what it builds. Ask for a landing page, small app, or docs site and get back a live *.space.fast URL. Spaces include a built-in database, versions, sharing, and custom domains. Sign-in uses OAuth, no API keys.
